file(GLOB welcome_rc_deps res/*.*)
add_rc_deps(welcome.rc ${welcome_rc_deps})

# welcome.exe is all Rust (welcome-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/welcome-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# welcome.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/welcome-rust/src/welcome/welcome.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(welcome_res OBJECT welcome.rc)
target_compile_definitions(welcome_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(welcome_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(welcome welcome-cargo welcome.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE welcome-rust
    DESTINATION reactos
    EXTRA_DEPENDS welcome_res)
add_cargo_cd_file(welcome DESTINATION root NO_CAB NAME_ON_CD setup.exe FOR bootcd)
